headline: A well-funded competitor just shipped **'chat with your schedule.'** Ordo7's had it since day one.
body: A well-funded, enterprise-priced competitor in this category just launched an AI feature that answers plain-language questions about your schedule — announced with new VP hires, sold through a sales cycle. Ask Ordo has done exactly that since the early build, on every plan including Free. No sales call required.
